resolved_state_families: empty / none selected: valid state; empty != error
loading / transitional: application state; loading != fictional delay
capability unavailable: technical state; unavailable != Character refusal
cancelled / failed attempt: no accepted Production mutation; failure != narrative event

resolved_rules: No active Scene remains a valid Production state and does not require invented Stage content or Scene lifecycle controls.
The same shell survives absence, loading, unavailable capability, failure/cancellation and provisionality without information-architecture redesign.
Transient application work preserves the prior semantic origin and focus-return target where possible.
Provider/runtime/recovery conditions remain infrastructure and do not become Character behavior, fictional time passage or causal history.
A failed or cancelled technical attempt does not imply accepted Production change, consequence or history.
Back/Close returns to retained context when valid and is not Undo.
